code: m = file_softmagic(ms, ubuf, nb, NULL, NULL, BINTEST, looks_text);
note: The input buffer is routed to the soft-magic matcher, where magic database rules consume offsets from the candidate.
The copy length can be shorter than the later 16-bit string conversion requirement; the safety obligation is that the bytes available for the requested value cover the conversion width.
For 16-bit string rules conversion only terminates the end of p->s and does not validate that each byte pair read by the string operation was present in the input.
The 16-bit string comparison consumes p->s according to the magic rule length, exposing bytes not guaranteed by the short input copy path.
